title: Tada
desc: This story revolves around Balraj Rana who lost his father to the underworld mafia, and now himself dons the mantle of a dreaded gangster.

title: Kisaan
desc: The story of a farmer, Maan Singh, who struggles to save his ancestral land from corrupt officials and greedy businessmen. With the help of his son, he fights against the system and stands up for his rights as a farmer. The movie highlights the challenges faced by farmers in modern India and explores themes of family, tradition, and social justice in a poignant and inspiring plot.

title: Kyaa Kool Hai Hum
desc: Living in Mumbai, Rahul and Karan dream of living luxurious lives despite their meagre salaries. When they get evicted from their apartment for not paying the rent, they hunt for rich girlfriends

title: Jhansi Ki Rani Lakshmibai
desc: Jhansi Ki Rani Lakshmibai tells the heroic story of Rani Lakshmibai, a fearless queen who led a valiant resistance against British rule. Defying all odds, she became a symbol of courage, sacrifice, and India's fight for freedom.
